title: Synthwave app promo — neon reel in six techniques

source.author: @trymirage
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the SPAM synthwave promo; structure and pacing follow it. Brand, icon, copy and handles are ours and fictional.

scenes: 01 ignition: dot, trim-path outline, app icon with stacked neon outlines
four camera-HUD cards: shoot / post / repeat / blast it (pixel type)
03 3D tunnel of photo cards with neon frames
04 parallax flyover: synthwave landscape, 3D pixel headline
05 product UI: phone feed, new-photos pill, like burst, counter
06 procedural grid: x1 → x4 → x16 → x64 icons, collapse to a flash
final: icon stack, chrome wordmark, typed tagline, footer
